checkRuns.command: bun run build 2>&1 | tail -15 && (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /books/nope /nope /about /contact; do echo "== $p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4701$p)"; done; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books/frankenstein | sed 's/<script.*<\/script>//g' | head -c 4000

cat > src/server.ts <<'EOF'
import process from 'node:process'
import { Elysia } from 'elysia'
import { pages } from 'kay/server'

// The site's own URL arrives as `ORIGIN`; kay reads it as `SITE_URL`, which actions check a post's origin against.
if (process.env.SITE_URL === undefined && process.env.ORIGIN !== undefined)
  process.env.SITE_URL = process.env.ORIGIN

// Exported for `kay check`, which checks links against the routes it serves besides the pages and types `ctx.locals` from its plugins.
export const app = new Elysia().use(await pages()).listen({ port: Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000), ...process.env.HOST !== undefined && { hostname: process.env.HOST } })
EOF
pkill -f "kay start"; sleep 0.5; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; cat /tmp/kay-server.log
U=http://127.0.0.1:4701/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/contact; H=(-H 'Referer: http://localhost:4701/contact' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' -H 'Host: localhost:4701')
echo "--- invalid"; curl -s -i "${H[@]}" --data-urlencode 'name=  ' --data-urlencode 'email=bad@x' --data-urlencode 'message=short' "$U" | sed 's/<script.*<\/script>//g' | grep -o 'HTTP/[^ ]* [0-9]*\|<main>.*</main>'
echo "--- empty email"; curl -s "${H[@]}" --data-urlencode 'name=Ann' --data-urlencode 'email=' --data-urlencode 'message=short' "$U" | grep -o '<main>.*</main>' | sed 's/<script.*<\/script>//g'
echo "--- valid"; curl -s -i -L -c /tmp/cj -b /tmp/cj "${H[@]}" --data-urlencode 'name=  Ann  ' --data-urlencode 'email=ann@example.com' --data-urlencode 'message=This is a long enough message.' "$U" | grep -o 'HTTP/[^ ]* [0-9]*\|^[Ll]ocation.*\|<main>.*</main>' | sed 's/<script.*<\/script>//g'

cat > /tmp/start.sh <<'EOF'
cd /home/kaynooo/.cache/llm-bench/opus-probe-1.48/kay-1/site
PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/kay.pid
sleep 2
EOF
cat > /tmp/stop.sh <<'EOF'
P=$(cat /tmp/kay.pid); pkill -P $P; kill $P 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5
EOF
cat > /tmp/form.sh <<'EOF'
U=http://127.0.0.1:4701/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/contact; H=(-H 'Referer: http://localhost:4701/contact' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' -H 'Host: localhost:4701')
strip() { sed 's/<script[^>]*>[^<]*<\/script>//g' | grep -o 'HTTP/[^ ]* [0-9]*\|^[Ll]ocation.*\|<main>.*</main>'; }
echo "--- invalid"; curl -s -i "${H[@]}" --data-urlencode 'name=  ' --data-urlencode 'email=bad@x' --data-urlencode 'message=short' "$U" | strip
echo "--- empty email"; curl -s -i "${H[@]}" --data-urlencode 'name=Ann' --data-urlencode 'email=' --data-urlencode 'message=short' "$U" | strip
echo "--- valid"; rm -f /tmp/cj; curl -s -i -L -c /tmp/cj -b /tmp/cj "${H[@]}" --data-urlencode 'name=  Ann  ' --data-urlencode 'email=ann@example.com' --data-urlencode 'message=This is a long enough message.' "$U" | strip
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2 && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && bash /tmp/start.sh && cat /tmp/kay-server.log && bash /tmp/form.sh

bash /tmp/stop.sh; bun test 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i -E "error|warn|fail" ; bash /tmp/start.sh && cat /tmp/kay-server.log && for p in / /books /books/dracula /books/x /x /about /contact; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4701$p) $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701$p | grep -o '<title>[^<]*')"; done && bash /tmp/form.sh | grep -o 'HTTP/1.1 [0-9]*\|Thanks[^<]*\|<span class="error">[^<]*'; bash /tmp/stop.sh; pgrep -af "kay start" | grep -v pgrep || echo "server stopped"
